protocol.status: Fixed longer-chain diagnostic; pending independent review before execution
protocol.policy: Fixed longer-run diagnostic after failed short gate; no automatic retries, extensions or production. Same seeds/initials/data/model: correlated diagnostic, not independent experiment. Preserve prior gate.

memory_policy.parallel_allocation_per_remaining_chain: max(2 * measured chain1 process-tree peak RSS through adaptation, 1 GiB)
memory_policy.basis: Operational safety factor/floor, not measured requirement or peak guarantee. Sum of process RSS can count shared pages repeatedly. Current/ancestor cgroup headroom checked before first and additional allocations.

protocol.phase_verification: Full installed runtime/library file inventory, pinned source/runtime identities, dispatcher and protocol hashes checked before preparation, chains and diagnostics; no production runtime modification.

scheduling.initial: Only prescribed chain1 starts; no extra model or replacement seed
scheduling.readiness: Existence only of chain1 adaptation.rds, independent of adaptation success or posterior values
scheduling.measurement: Sample chain1 process-tree RSS every0.2 seconds through adaptation; require positive sample before parallel release
scheduling.remaining: Launch prescribed2–4 concurrently only if measured headroom supports all pending chains; otherwise serialize remaining. Without adaptation record or positive RSS sample use serial execution. Preserve resource-blocked not_launched outcomes.

initial_memory.basis: Operational allocation floor of 1 GiB per chain; not measured peak RSS or a guarantee of sufficient memory.

meaning: Execution accounting only; no convergence classification.

before_chains_memory.basis: Operational allocation floor of 1 GiB per chain; not measured peak RSS or a guarantee of sufficient memory.
